title: Wuthering Heights
review: It’s a retelling on the story that features Charli XCX and is more salacious than the source material. I thought the age differences between the actors is too distracting. I can’t suspend disbelief that Hong Chau, Margot Robbie, and Jacob Elordi are around the same age. I particularly disliked Chau in this and thought she did a poor job with the British accent. It’s also because her character is a villain and seems to cause all of the conflict in the film. The third act was just Cathy being sad, Nelly burning letters, and Heathcliff torturing Isabella. I would’ve liked to see more characterization for Heathcliff to understand how he became wealthy and what he’s done for the past 5 years.
